note: Selectors are evaluated with document.querySelectorAll on the web page (each resolves from the rendered stock source: test ids, classes and structure that already exist). A native renderer ignores them and emits the same names and keys. Fields: name, selector, description; textSized (width comes from the element's own text); text (record the element's text); textRange (box is the element's own text node, for a label that is a bare text node); hoverOnly (drawn only on hover: recorded only when visible); key (how an instance is told apart: the attribute of the element itself, its closest ancestor, or a descendant, with a prefix stripped), else the instance's index among its name.

elements.name: tab-label

elements.name: tab-close

elements.name: status-bar

elements.name: status-location

elements.name: status-dot
elements.description: The connection dot: green when the focused host is online, yellow when reconnecting.

elements.name: status-host

elements.name: status-cwd

elements.name: status-branch
elements.description: The branch block: its mark and name, at most 45% of the left block.

elements.name: status-branch-icon

elements.name: status-branch-name

elements.name: status-details

elements.name: zoom-indicator
elements.description: The zoom percentage button, present while the zoom is not 100%.

elements.name: status-detail

elements.name: status-usage

elements.name: usage-unavailable

elements.name: usage-window

elements.name: status-connection

elements.name: status-connection-glyph

elements.name: navigator-scrim
elements.description: The dimming layer over the whole window (55% black); a press on it closes the palette.

elements.name: navigator-panel
elements.description: The palette: at most 560px wide and 480px high, centred, its top 12% of the window down; rounded, on the panel fill with a shadow.

elements.name: navigator-input
elements.description: The search field across the top (surface fill, 0.95rem); `text` is what was typed, `placeholder` what shows while it is empty.

elements.name: navigator-chips
elements.description: The row of state chips under the field.

elements.name: navigator-chip
elements.description: One chip (All, Working, Blocked, Done, Idle); the chosen one is on the lighter fill in the accent colour.

elements.name: navigator-list
elements.description: The scrolling list of notices, commands and sessions.

elements.name: navigator-notice
elements.description: A line of status or error text: Searching files, the shell-mode hint, a search error (red).

elements.name: navigator-empty
elements.description: No matches, centred.

elements.name: navigator-command

elements.name: navigator-command-title
elements.description: Its name.

elements.name: navigator-command-detail
elements.description: Its folder or help, right aligned, small, in the muted colour.

elements.name: navigator-row
elements.description: One session row; the highlighted one is on the lighter fill.

elements.name: navigator-row-dot
elements.description: The session's status mark: its agent's icon in a ring of its state's colour.

elements.name: navigator-row-title
elements.description: The session's title (bold for the one on screen).

elements.name: navigator-row-detail
elements.description: Its folder, with the host's name before it when it is not this machine.

elements.name: navigator-note
elements.description: The footnote under the list while files are searched: where, and what is skipped.

elements.name: pane-menu

elements.name: pane-menu-item

elements.name: pane-menu-divider
elements.description: The hairline before the red rows.

elements.name: pane-menu-rename-row
elements.description: The rename row: the field and OK, replacing the rows.

elements.name: pane-menu-rename-input
elements.description: The rename field (surface fill), holding the pane's title.

elements.name: pane-menu-rename-confirm
elements.description: Its OK button (primary).

elements.name: confirm-scrim
elements.description: The dimming layer over the whole window (55% black); a press on it cancels.

elements.name: confirm-panel

elements.name: confirm-message

elements.name: confirm-extra

elements.name: confirm-buttons

elements.name: confirm-cancel

elements.name: confirm-accept

elements.name: dialog-scrim

elements.name: dialog-panel

elements.name: dialog-title

elements.name: dialog-input
elements.description: The caller's field: surface fill, 0.85rem; `text` is its value.

elements.name: dialog-hint

elements.name: dialog-error
elements.description: The caller's error line (red).

elements.name: dialog-buttons
elements.description: The caller's row of buttons, right aligned.

elements.name: dialog-cancel
elements.description: Cancel.

elements.name: dialog-confirm

elements.name: toast-open

elements.name: toast-mark

elements.name: toast-heading

elements.name: toast-detail

elements.name: toast-dismiss

elements.name: pane-controls

elements.name: pane-close

elements.description: Its cross.

elements.name: pane-corner
elements.description: The corner variant's box: top right, 4px in, on the panel fill, rounded.

elements.name: launcher

elements.name: launcher-filter
